name: ecuador-tenders-scraper
title: Ecuador Government Tenders Scraper (SERCOP OCDS)
description: Scrapes Ecuador's official Servicio Nacional de Contratacion Publica (SERCOP) open-data OCDS platform -- search public procurement processes by keyword and year, and fetch full OCDS (Open Contracting Data Standard) release history for any record. No account or login needed.
